entries.title: K16-C3-M3-ROUTE-TRIVIAL-SPLIT-CYCLE
entries.payload:
/ FULL M_rel^2 MODULUS SURVIVES / GLOBAL MOVING-SUPPORT SAVING OPEN.


Retain Section 36:
X_sym=T_1-T_3,
Y_sym=T_2-D,
X_sym+rho_rel*Y_sym ==0 mod M_rel^2,
rho_rel^2==-1 mod M_rel^2.


We now audit fresh content prime by prime.


Fix p^a||m_1=tau_1^sharp and choose the oriented Gaussian prime pi above p contained in G_1^sharp.


From the Section-24 variables,
v_pi(C)=2a,
v_pi(s)=-2a,
v_pi(t)=-2a.


Hence
C*s,
C*t,
t/s
are pi-adic units.


The target anti-root is
v_1^2
=
Lambda(C*s)*Lambda(t/s)*Lambda(C*t).


M3-T11-029 gives
A_1 == rho_1*B_1 mod p^(2a),
with p not dividing B_1 and rho_1 a p-adic unit.
Therefore p does not divide A_1 and v_1 is a p-adic unit.


The retained fresh-unit filter from M3-T11-026/027 gives
p not dividing Lambda(t/s).


Each of
Lambda(C*s), Lambda(C*t), Lambda(t/s)
is pi-adically integral.
Their product v_1^2 is a p-unit, and Lambda(t/s) is a p-unit.
Therefore necessarily
boxed:
p does not divide Lambda(C*s)*Lambda(C*t).


Now
v_2^2=Lambda(C)*Lambda(t)*Lambda(C*t),
v_3^2=Lambda(C)*Lambda(s)*Lambda(C*s).


Because v_pi(C)=2a and v_pi(s)=v_pi(t)=-2a,
boxed:
v_pi(Lambda(C))
=
v_pi(Lambda(s))
=
v_pi(Lambda(t))
=
-2a.


The remaining factors Lambda(C*t), Lambda(C*s) are p-units by the previous paragraph.
Hence exactly
boxed:
v_p(v_2)=v_p(v_3)=-2a.


Since v_j=A_j/B_j are reduced,
boxed:
v_p(B_2)=v_p(B_3)=2a,
and
p does not divide A_2*A_3.
Also p does not divide A_1*B_1.


Substitute these valuations into the Section-36 coefficients.


Modulo p^(2a):
T_1 == 0,
D == 0,
T_2 == A_2*A_3*B_1,
T_3 == A_1*A_2*A_3.


Therefore
boxed:
X_sym == -A_1*A_2*A_3 mod p^(2a),
boxed:
Y_sym == A_2*A_3*B_1 mod p^(2a).


In particular
boxed:
p does not divide X_sym*Y_sym.


By cyclic symmetry the same holds for every p|m_2 and every p|m_3.


Thus
boxed:
gcd(X_sym,Y_sym,M_rel)=1.


Consequently the Section-36 congruence is a primitive Gaussian root line modulo the full squared modulus M_rel^2:
boxed:
X_sym+rho_rel*Y_sym ==0 mod M_rel^2,
boxed:
rho_rel^2==-1 mod M_rel^2,
boxed:
gcd(X_sym,Y_sym,M_rel)=1.


Equivalently
boxed:
M_rel^2 | X_sym^2+Y_sym^2
with no fresh-prime content loss.


This is the corrected legal replacement for the false Section-31 common-v joint root line.


### 37.1 What is and is not closed


The local primitive-modulus blocker from Section 36 is closed.


AR-009 is now algebraically applicable to the common coefficient pair (X_sym,Y_sym) with modulus M_rel^2.


However a global active-M_rel saving still requires an exact height/range and multiplicity adapter for this coefficient pair on the same physical packet measure.
Do not multiply an ambient 1/M_rel^2 lattice density into an already-charged endpoint count.


The next theorem-level task is therefore:
ThreeAntiRootCubicCoefficientRootLineRangeAdapter.


It must bound the physical coefficient-pair box/height and pushforward multiplicity strongly enough that the full primitive M_rel^2 root line yields a fixed-power deficit in moving M_rel support.

## 38. No-double-charge correction for the cubic coefficient root line


Status: EXACT FACTORIZATION / RANGE-ADAPTER ATTACK FROZEN AS INDEPENDENT SAVING / M3-T11-032 AND 033 RETAINED AS ALGEBRAIC ROUTERS.


Retain
F_v(X)=product_{i=1}^3(B_i*X-A_i)
and
F_v(X)=D*X^3-T_1*X^2+T_2*X-T_3.


With
X_sym=T_1-T_3,
Y_sym=T_2-D,
one has exactly
boxed:
X_sym+i*Y_sym=F_v(i)
=product_{i=1}^3(i*B_i-A_i).


Taking Gaussian norms gives
boxed:
X_sym^2+Y_sym^2
=
product_{i=1}^3(A_i^2+B_i^2).


Therefore the full divisibility
M_rel^2 | X_sym^2+Y_sym^2
is exactly the Gaussian product packaging of the three already-known one-core norm divisibilities
m_i^2 | A_i^2+B_i^2.


The M3-T11-032/033 CRT and primitivity statements remain algebraically correct.
What is retracted is the idea that an AR-009 count on the product coefficient pair can supply a new independent moving-support density saving merely after a range adapter.


Any such charge would reuse the same three one-core root-line conditions through Gaussian multiplication.


This is a direct realization of the pre-existing Section-31 firewall:
do not multiply three relative root-line savings.

## 39. Symmetric-u fresh-conductor transfer versus scaled anti-root collision


Status: NEW EXACT SAME-MEASURE ROUTER / MOVING-SUPPORT SAVING OPEN.


Retain the M3-T11-031 symmetric quantities
S=v_1+v_2+v_3,
E=v_1*v_2+v_1*v_3+v_2*v_3,
P=v_1*v_2*v_3.


On the finite-u branch
SE+P != 0,
define
boxed:
u=P/(SE+P).


This agrees with the Section-35 rational parameterization.


### 39.1 Primewise valuation formula


Fix p^a||m_1 and put
q=p^(2a).


By M3-T11-033,
v_p(v_1)=0,
v_p(v_2)=v_p(v_3)=-2a.


Write in Q_p
alpha=v_1,
beta=q*v_2,
gamma=q*v_3.
Then alpha,beta,gamma are p-units.


A direct substitution into u=P/(SE+P) gives exactly
boxed:
u
=
alpha*beta*gamma*q
/
[
 beta*gamma*(beta+gamma)
 +alpha*q*(beta^2+4*beta*gamma+gamma^2)
 +alpha^2*q^2*(beta+gamma)
].


Now M3-T11-033 also gives
m_1^2 | B_2,
m_1^2 | B_3,
and
gcd(B_2/m_1^2,m_1)
=
gcd(B_3/m_1^2,m_1)
=
1.


Define
Bhat_2^(1)=B_2/m_1^2,
Bhat_3^(1)=B_3/m_1^2,
and the normalized collision numerator
boxed:
H_1
=
A_2*Bhat_3^(1)
+
A_3*Bhat_2^(1).


Equivalently,
boxed:
v_2+v_3
=
H_1
/
[
m_1^2*Bhat_2^(1)*Bhat_3^(1)
].


For p^a||m_1 one has exactly
v_p(beta+gamma)=v_p(H_1).


Let e=v_p(H_1).


If e<2a, the first term in the displayed denominator of u has valuation e, while every other term has valuation at least 2a. Hence
boxed:
v_p(u)=2a-e.


If e>=2a, no positive p-adic numerator gain is claimed.


Therefore, for u written in lowest terms,
boxed:
m_1^2/gcd(m_1^2,H_1)
divides Num(u).


Cyclically define
H_2
=
A_1*(B_3/m_2^2)
+
A_3*(B_1/m_2^2),


H_3
=
A_1*(B_2/m_3^2)
+
A_2*(B_1/m_3^2).


Since m_1,m_2,m_3 are pairwise coprime,
boxed:
Q_u
:=
product_{i=1}^3
[
m_i^2/gcd(m_i^2,H_i)
]
divides Num(u).


Define the complementary collision content
boxed:
C_u
:=
product_{i=1}^3 gcd(m_i^2,H_i).


Then exactly
boxed:
Q_u*C_u=M_rel^2.


Hence
boxed:
max(Q_u,C_u)>=M_rel.


### 39.2 New same-measure dichotomy


On the large fresh-conductor branch
M_rel>B^(1/12-eta),
every endpoint on the finite-u branch satisfies at least one of:


A. u-transfer branch:
Q_u>=M_rel,
so Num(u) carries a divisor at least M_rel;


B. scaled-collision branch:
C_u>=M_rel,
so a polynomial portion of the squared fresh conductor is absorbed by the three explicit normalized anti-root collision numerators H_i.


This is not a density theorem by itself.


Branch A still needs a same-measure height/support theorem for realized u.
Branch B still needs a same-measure cross-gcd/collision theorem for gcd(m_i^2,H_i).


The projective exceptional branch SE+P=0, corresponding to u=infinity in Section 35, is not included in the finite-u transfer and remains a separate lower-dimensional branch to audit.


Semantic anti-loop verdict:
this is not another pointwise root-line recombination.
It uses the symmetric parameter u from M3-T11-031 and gives a new primewise conservation law that accounts exactly for where the fresh conductor goes:
into Num(u) or into an explicit scaled collision cross-gcd.

## 40. Retraction of Section 39 finite-u transfer


Status: RETRACTED.


Section 39 used the inverse parameter
u=P/(S*E+P).


That inverse is missing one factor S.


From
r=P/S=4*u^2/(1+u^2)
and
y=(E+r)/S=4*u/(1+u^2),
the correct inverse is
boxed:
u=P*S/(S*E+P).


Indeed
(P*S)/(S*E+P)=u,
whereas
P/(S*E+P)=u/S.


Therefore the claimed Section-39 valuation transfer
Q_u | Num(u)
and the product law
Q_u*C_u=M_rel^2
as a fresh-conductor conservation statement are withdrawn.


M3-T11-034 is RETRACTED.
No theorem credit or endpoint credit was attached to it.


Flags:
M3_T11_034_RETRACTED=true
M3_T11_SYMMETRIC_U_FRESH_TRANSFER=false
P_OVER_M3_LIMIT_PROVED=false




## 41. Correct symmetric common-u full fresh root line


Status: NEW EXACT SAME-MEASURE ADAPTER / GENUINE COMMON RATIONAL ROOT LINE / MOVING SUPPORT OPEN.


Retain M3-T11-031 and M3-T11-033.


On the nondegenerate endpoint locus,
P=v_1*v_2*v_3 !=0.
The symmetric relation
(S*E+P)^2=S^2*P*(4*S-P)
then implies S!=0, because S=0 would force P=0.


Define
boxed:
r=P/S.


Since
S=T_1/D,
P=T_3/D,
one has exactly
boxed:
r=T_3/T_1.


### 41.1 Full fresh square in the reduced denominator of r


For every p^a||m_1, M3-T11-033 gives:
A_1,A_2,A_3,B_1 are p-units,
while
p^(2a) exactly divides the fresh part of both B_2 and B_3.


Hence every term of
T_1
=
A_1*B_2*B_3
+
A_2*B_1*B_3
+
A_3*B_1*B_2
is divisible by p^(2a).


Thus p^(2a)|T_1.


Cyclically,
boxed:
M_rel^2 | T_1.


Also
T_3=A_1*A_2*A_3
is coprime to M_rel.


Therefore reducing r=T_3/T_1 cannot cancel any fresh prime, and
boxed:
M_rel^2 | Den(r).


This is an exact full-conductor statement on one common rational symmetric coordinate.


### 41.2 Pass from r to the genuine common-u Gaussian root line


M3-T11-031 gives
boxed:
r=4*u^2/(1+u^2).


On the large fresh branch M_rel>1, r cannot equal 4, because Den(r) is divisible by M_rel^2>1.
Hence the projective u=infinity branch is absent there.


Write the now-finite rational parameter in lowest terms
boxed:
u=A_u/B_u,
gcd(A_u,B_u)=1.


Then
r=4*A_u^2/(A_u^2+B_u^2).


Because
gcd(A_u^2,A_u^2+B_u^2)=1,
the reduction factor
g_u
=
gcd(4*A_u^2,A_u^2+B_u^2)
=
gcd(4,A_u^2+B_u^2)
belongs to {1,2}.


Thus
boxed:
Den(r)
=
(A_u^2+B_u^2)/g_u.


All m_i and M_rel are odd.
Therefore
boxed:
M_rel^2 | A_u^2+B_u^2.


Also gcd(B_u,M_rel)=1, since otherwise primitivity would force the same fresh prime into A_u.


Hence there is a unique residue
rho_u=A_u*B_u^(-1) mod M_rel^2
with
boxed:
rho_u^2==-1 mod M_rel^2,
and
boxed:
A_u==rho_u*B_u mod M_rel^2.


This is a valid common rational root line on one actual symmetric parameter u.
It is not the retracted Section-31 false common-v statement.


### 41.3 Exact norm carrier and support consequence


Since r=T_3/T_1,
the reduced denominator is
Den(r)=|T_1|/gcd(T_1,T_3).


Therefore
boxed:
A_u^2+B_u^2
=
g_u*|T_1|/gcd(T_1,T_3),
with g_u in {1,2}.


In particular the Gaussian norm of the common-u pair divides 2*|T_1| and is polynomially bounded under the exact physical R<=B packet.


For one fixed realized u,
every compatible M_rel satisfies
M_rel^2 | A_u^2+B_u^2.
Hence the number of possible M_rel values over one fixed u is divisor-many:
boxed:
# {M_rel compatible with fixed u}
=
B^o(1)
uniformly on the physical polynomial range.


Therefore, per fixed content/coefficient packet,
boxed:
# active M_rel
<=
B^o(1) * # active realized u.


A sufficient replacement target is now:
boxed:
# active realized u
<<
B^(1/12-delta).


This does not yet prove the target.
The common-u root-line is still a pointwise congruence, and no independent density factor may be multiplied without a same-measure counting theorem.


The fixed-u genus-one quartic from M3-T11-031 remains available, but no required uniform moving-u point bound has yet been proved.

## 42. Fixed-field cubic-torsion upgrade on the symmetric (S,u) incidence
Status: PROVISIONAL EXACT/THEOREM ADAPTER / HOSTILE AUDIT REQUIRED BEFORE CANONICAL PROMOTION.


Retain M3-T11-031 and M3-T11-035.  On the nondegenerate endpoint locus,
S=v_1+v_2+v_3 != 0,
and the exact split-cubic discriminant condition is
Y^2=-(1+u^2) Q(S,u),
where
Q(S,u)
=
-4*S^2+S^4+48*S*u-16*S^3*u-16*u^2+44*S^2*u^2+S^4*u^2.
The current common-u gate remains open; this section upgrades the previously-open fixed-fiber multiplicity only.


### 42.1 Fixed-u Jacobian has 3-torsion over one fixed quadratic field
For fixed rational nonzero u, view
f_u(S)=-(1+u^2)Q(S,u)
as a binary quartic.  With the standard invariants
I=12ae-3bd+c^2,
J=72ace+9bcd-27ad^2-27b^2e-2c^3,
one obtains exactly
I_u=16*(1+u^2)^3*(1+109*u^2),
J_u=128*(1+u^2)^4*(-1+268*u^2+1727*u^4).


Use the rationally isomorphic Jacobian model
E_u: y^2=x^3-27*I_u*x-27*J_u.
Its 3-division polynomial factors with the linear factor
x+36*(1+u^2)^2.
At
x_u=-36*(1+u^2)^2
one has exactly
y_u^2
=
-6912*(1+u^2)^4*(25*u^2-2)^2
=
[48*sqrt(-3)*(1+u^2)^2*(25*u^2-2)]^2.
Hence over the fixed number field
K=Q(sqrt(-3))
the point
P_u=
(
 -36*(1+u^2)^2,
 48*sqrt(-3)*(1+u^2)^2*(25*u^2-2)
)
lies on E_u and is killed by the 3-division polynomial.


For rational u, the exceptional equation u^2=2/25 has no solution in Q.  The rational u=0 branch is absent on the nondegenerate endpoint locus because P=v_1*v_2*v_3 is nonzero.  Thus y_u is nonzero and P_u has exact order 3 for every physical rational u under consideration.


This removes the earlier objection that no uniform torsion input had been identified over Q: rational torsion over Q is unnecessary for the Dujella theorem, because the theorem is uniform over any one fixed number field K and the physical Q-rational image is a subset of E_u(K).


### 42.2 Uniform fixed-u physical multiplicity candidate
The quartic-to-Jacobian map is a fixed-degree binary-quartic covering map.  On the exact physical R<=B packet, the Gaussian-core coordinates have polynomial height; hence the corrected anti-roots v_i, their symmetric sum S, the common parameter u from M3-T11-035, the quartic coefficients, and the image point on E_u all have height B^O(1).


Marta Dujella's uniform bounded-height theorem for elliptic curves over a fixed number field carrying a rational point of exact prime order therefore applies over K=Q(sqrt(-3)) with prime order 3.  It gives
# {E_u(K) points of physical-induced height B^O(1)}
=
exp(O_K(log B/log log B))
=
B^o(1)
uniformly in the realized rational u.


Since physical quartic points are Q-rational, map into E_u(Q) subset E_u(K), and the covering degree is fixed, the candidate conclusion is
boxed:
fixed realized u + fixed content/coefficient packet
=> B^o(1) physical endpoint states.


This is a theorem-promotion boundary and is not made canonical in mainbatch without hostile audit.


### 42.3 Symmetric fixed-S fiber has the same fixed-field torsion
The same incidence is quartic in u when S is fixed.  Its u-discriminant factors exactly as
1048576*S^2*(S^2-8)^3*(1+S^2)^6.
Physical S is nonzero; S^2=8 has no rational solution.  Hence every physical fixed-rational-S fiber is smooth.


For the corresponding binary quartic in u, the scaled Jacobian has a 3-division linear factor with
x_S=-36*(S^2-2)^2,
and at this x-coordinate
y_S^2
=
-27648*(S^2-8)^2*(1+S^2)^4
=
[96*sqrt(-3)*(S^2-8)*(1+S^2)^2]^2.
Therefore the fixed-S Jacobian also has an exact K-rational point of order 3, uniformly over the same fixed field K=Q(sqrt(-3)).


Subject to the same polynomial-height adapter, this gives the second candidate conclusion
boxed:
fixed realized S + fixed content/coefficient packet
=> B^o(1) physical endpoint states.


### 42.4 Exact square-split addendum and anti-loop verdict
From M3-T11-035,
r=T_3/T_1=4*u^2/(1+u^2),
so exactly
boxed:
u^2=T_3/(4*T_1-T_3).


Writing u=A_u/B_u in lowest terms gives an exact common-squareclass split:
there is an integer G such that, up to the common physical sign,
T_3=G*A_u^2,
4*T_1-T_3=G*B_u^2,
4*T_1=G*(A_u^2+B_u^2).


Moreover
G=gcd(T_3,4*T_1-T_3)=gcd(T_3,4*T_1).
If d=gcd(T_1,T_3), comparison with the already-proved
A_u^2+B_u^2=g_u*|T_1|/d,
g_u in {1,2},
shows
G=4*d/g_u
up to the common sign.
Thus this square-split is not a new independent density factor; it is a normalized restatement of the M3-T11-035 common-u norm carrier.  No second squareclass saving may be charged from it.


### 42.5 What this changes and what remains open
If hostile audit validates the binary-quartic invariant calculation, exact K-rational 3-torsion, Dujella applicability, and polynomial-height transfer, then the former flag
M3_T11_THREE_ANTIROOT_FIXED_U_UNIFORM_BO1_PROVED=false
may be promoted to true, and an additional fixed-S B^o(1) fiber theorem may be registered.


This does NOT prove
# active realized u << B^(1/12-delta).
The moving-u support deficit remains the load-bearing missing theorem.  The common-u full M_rel^2 root line remains pointwise and cannot be multiplied by the new fixed-fiber B^o(1) statement as an independent density.

## 43. Hostile-audit promotion of M3-T11-036
Status: CANONICAL / HOSTILE AUDIT PASS / FIXED-FIBER UNIFORMITY CLOSED.


Independent stage37audit returned PASS for the complete M3-T11-036 promotion boundary:
1. fixed-u binary-quartic invariants;
2. exact order-3 torsion over K=Q(sqrt(-3));
3. symmetric fixed-S version;
4. Marta Dujella fixed-number-field theorem applicability;
5. polynomial physical-height transfer through v_i -> S,u -> quartic -> Jacobian.


Therefore the provisional conclusions from Section 42 are now canonical:
boxed:
fixed realized u + fixed content/coefficient packet
=> B^o(1) physical endpoint states,
and
boxed:
fixed realized S + fixed content/coefficient packet
